name: First-use empty state
summary: What a new area shows before anything is in it: what it is for, in one sentence, and the one action that starts it.
use: the first time someone opens a list, board or folder that has nothing in it yet
a11y: The drawing is decorative and hidden; the heading names the area, and the single action is a real button.

use_when: a person opens a feature for the first time
a new workspace has no items of this kind
avoid_when: a search found nothing: use empty-no-results
a filter hid everything: use empty-filtered
keyboard: Tab reaches Create a project; Enter or Space presses it

empty.how: This part is the empty state itself.

loading.how: the Smart UI renderer draws each marked slot as a quiet block of its size while the data arrives; the static file shows the filled part

error.how: Not applicable: an error isn't an empty list. Use page-banners or page-error.

disabled.how: No control here is ever disabled; each one always does something.

overflow.how: Actions stack full width under 30rem; the panel caps its width.

long_text.how: Titles balance and body text wraps at word boundaries inside a capped measure.

missing_image.how: The part has no picture; its drawing is an inline icon.
